incidents.text: Ryan Gravenberch sends a superb cross into the box. Virgil van Dijk (Netherlands) latches on to it and from close range plants a header in off the right post, leaving Zion Suzuki beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
It's in the back of the net! Keito Nakamura (Japan) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Bart Verbruggen. He makes it 1:1.
Ismail Elfath shows the yellow card to Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) for a heavy challenge.
Goal! Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) neatly controls a decent pass from Ryan Gravenberch. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 2:1.
Substitution. Daizen Maeda makes way for Junya Ito (Japan).
We are about to witness a subsitution. Memphis Depay (Netherlands) for Donyell Malen.
Ronald Koeman has decided to substitute Crysencio Summerville and he is replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands).
That's the end of the game for Tijjani Reijnders, who is replaced by Quinten Timber (Netherlands).
Hajime Moriyasu prepares a substitution. Tsuyoshi Watanabe is replaced by Takehiro Tomiyasu (Japan).
Takefusa Kubo (Japan) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Koki Ogawa replaces him.
Substitution. Yukinari Sugawara (Japan) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ritsu Doan walks off.
Ryan Gravenberch will be replaced by Nathan Ake (Netherlands).
Ismail Elfath shows a yellow card to Memphis Depay (Netherlands), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
Hajime Moriyasu has decided to make a change. Kento Shiogai (Japan) replaces Ayase Ueda.
That will be all from Cody Gakpo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Brian Brobbey (Netherlands).
Goal! Koki Ogawa gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Daichi Kamada (Japan) glances a header into the net. 2:2.
A yellow card for a tackle by Micky van de Ven (Netherlands). Ismail Elfath doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
